title: An Empirical Study of Gas Optimization Practices in Solidity Smart Contracts
abstract: arXiv:2610.40885v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In the Ethereum ecosystem, smart contract execution is governed by a gas model where every computational operation incurs a direct economic cost. Consequently, gas efficiency is a critical requirement for the economic sustainability and widespread adoption of decentralized applications. Despite the importance of cost-effective development, there remains a significant gap between theoretical optimization patterns and the actual practices applied by developers in real-world projects. This paper presents an empirical study investigating gas optimization practices in open-source Solidity repositories created on GitHub between 2018 and 2025. Adopting a Mining Software Repositories approach, we analyzed a dataset of gas-related commits identified through a multi-stage pipeline involving NLP-based filtering and manual qualitative inspection. Based on the analysis of 400 representative commits, we derive an empirical taxonomy of gas optimization

translated_title: Solidity智能合约中Gas优化实践的实证研究
translated_abstract: 在以太坊生态系统中，智能合约的执行受gas模型约束，每一项计算操作都会产生直接的经济成本。因此，gas效率是去中心化应用实现经济可持续性和广泛普及的关键要求。尽管低成本开发至关重要，但理论上的优化模式与开发者在实际项目中所采用的真实实践之间仍存在显著差距。本文对2018年至2025年间在GitHub上创建的开源Solidity仓库中的gas优化实践进行了实证研究。采用软件仓库挖掘方法，我们通过一个包含基于NLP的筛选和人工定性检查的多阶段流程，识别出与gas相关的提交数据集并进行了分析。基于对400个代表性提交的分析，我们得出了gas优化实践的实证分类体系。
tldr: 该论文通过对2018至2025年间GitHub上开源Solidity仓库中400个与gas相关提交的多阶段实证分析，构建了智能合约gas优化实践的分类体系，并揭示了理论优化模式与开发者真实实践之间的显著差距。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an empirical study of 400 gas-related commits from open-source Solidity repositories on GitHub (2018-2025), deriving an empirical taxonomy of gas optimization practices and revealing a significant gap between theoretical optimization patterns and real-world developer practices.
